items.html: And from this nose of the holy Atika, which is drawn from the third head, the Moach Stimaa of the Atika — from it is drawn to the precious beard of ZA. And I have already informed you that the beard of ZA is only six Tikunim, because its root is the holy Vav of HaVaYaH, and it has only VAK. But afterwards NHY were added to him, and then were completed in his beard nine Tikunim. And this is what is said in the Idra Zuta: "Six they are, nine they are called," etc. And when ZA ascends, in the Mincha prayer of Shabbat, until the beard of the holy Atika, ascending to the eighth correction, called the upper Mazal, and not including it, then are completed in him the thirteen Tikunim of his beard. For he ascended through those four lower Tikunim of the beard of the holy Atika, which are the ninth, the tenth, the eleventh, and the twelfth. For the thirteenth correction, called the lower Mazal, we have already explained that it is the inclusion of all the twelve above it.
